deduplication: Stable source-scoped identifiers are idempotency keys. Cross-source matches are candidates only and are never merged automatically.

sources.name: Data.gov Catalog API
sources.notes: The Catalog API uses an API key and may throttle the shared DEMO_KEY. The public search page is a no-key metadata-only fallback; both identify datasets, not their underlying data.

sources.name: Farmers.gov farm loans page
sources.notes: One public reference record only; not treated as a structured program API.

sources.name: USDA Farmers.gov Data and Reports directory
sources.notes: Directory metadata points to official USDA program-data and historical/planning resources. Directory references are context only, not program criteria or eligibility results; each linked data source requires separate review and ingestion.

sources.name: GSA Per Diem API
sources.notes: Uses public api.data.gov DEMO_KEY for bounded exploration.

sources.name: Grants.gov funding opportunities API
sources.notes: Unauthenticated search2 and fetchOpportunity APIs; the bounded inventory is posted funding-opportunity metadata, not a complete federal benefits catalog or eligibility rules. Preserve Grants.gov source attribution and the required non-endorsement notice.

sources.name: Maryland Farmers Markets API
sources.notes: Official state portal. Small sample allowlists name, county, dates, and source benefit label; contact and precise location fields are discarded.

sources.name: Social Security Administration OASDI statistics
sources.notes: Official bulk JSON returned HTTP 403 from the hosted environment; no personal data or SSNs are collected.
